751.translation: To send down upon them stones of clay,
And certainly did We create man from an extract of clay.

752.translation: For the like of this let the workers [on earth] work.
And say to those who do not believe, "Work according to your position; indeed, we are working.

753.translation: Indeed, We have given you, [O Muḥammad], a clear conquest
When the victory of Allāh has come and the conquest,

754.translation: O mankind, you are those in need of Allāh, while Allāh is the Free of need, the Praiseworthy.
So he watered [their flocks] for them; then he went back to the shade and said, "My Lord, indeed I am, for whatever good You would send down to me, in need."

755.translation: I will surely cut off your hands and your feet on opposite sides; then I will surely crucify you all."
So would you perhaps, if you turned away, cause corruption on earth and sever your [ties of] relationship?

756.translation: Then We would have cut from him the aorta.
That He might cut down a section of the disbelievers or suppress them so that they turn back disappointed.

757.translation: [Satan] said, "Because You have put me in error, I will surely sit in wait for them [i.e., mankind] on Your straight path.
Do not make [as equal] with Allāh another deity and [thereby] become censured and forsaken.

758.translation: Indeed, We guided him to the way, be he grateful or be he ungrateful.
[By] that We repaid them because they disbelieved. And do We [thus] repay except the ungrateful?

759.translation: And the meat of fowl, from whatever they desire.
And We will provide them with fruit and meat from whatever they desire.

760.translation: [Some angels said], "Do not flee but return to where you were given luxury and to your homes - perhaps you will be questioned."
And you lived among the dwellings of those who wronged themselves, and it had become clear to you how We dealt with them. And We presented for you [many] examples."

761.translation: Indeed, what you are promised is coming, and you will not cause failure [to Allāh].
Or that He would not seize them during their [usual] activity, and they could not cause failure [i.e., escape from Him]?

762.translation: [Moses] said, "O Aaron, what prevented you, when you saw them going astray,
Or do they have gods to defend them other than Us? They are unable [even] to help themselves, nor can they be protected from Us.

763.gloss: (is) surely the promised place for them
763.translation: And indeed, Hell is the promised place for them all.
But the Hour is their appointment [for due punishment], and the Hour is more disastrous and more bitter.

764.translation: From a sperm-drop when it is emitted
From a sperm-drop He created him and destined for him;

765.translation: And We removed from you your burden
That no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another

766.translation: Then on that Day, the Occurrence [i.e., Resurrection] will occur,

767.translation: And establish them in the land and show Pharaoh and [his minister] Hāmān and their soldiers through them that which they had feared.
And obey Allāh and obey the Messenger and beware. And if you turn away - then know that upon Our Messenger is only [the responsibility for] clear notification.

768.translation: [Satan] said, "Reprieve me until the Day they are resurrected."
He said, "My Lord, then reprieve me until the Day they are resurrected."

769.translation: This [Qur’ān] is enlightenment for mankind and guidance and mercy for a people who are certain [in faith].
Or did they create the heavens and the earth? Rather, they are not certain.

770.translation: He has enumerated them and counted them a [full] counting.
But all things We have enumerated in writing.

771.translation: If He wills, He can do away with you and bring forth a new creation.
And remove the fury in their [i.e., the believers'] hearts. And Allāh turns in forgiveness to whom He wills; and Allāh is Knowing and Wise.

772.translation: Say, "Not equal are the evil and the good, although the abundance of evil might impress you." So fear Allāh, O you of understanding, that you may be successful.
And let not their wealth and their children impress you. Allāh only intends to punish them through them in this world and that their souls should depart [at death] while they are disbelievers.

773.translation: And We certainly tried Solomon and placed on his throne a body; then he returned.
But those who have avoided ṭāghūt, lest they worship it, and turned back to Allāh - for them are good tidings. So give good tidings to My servants

774.translation: Then, surely it is We who are most knowing of those most worthy of burning therein.

775.translation: And the soldiers of Iblees, all together.
Except Iblees; he was arrogant and became among the disbelievers.

776.translation: Indeed, it [i.e., the Fire] is of the greatest [afflictions]
One of the women said, "O my father, hire him. Indeed, the best one you can hire is the strong and the trustworthy."

777.translation: Then it appeared to them after they had seen the signs that he [i.e., al-ʿAzeez] should surely imprison him for a time.
And there will appear to them the evils they had earned, and they will be enveloped by what they used to ridicule.

778.translation: And those who, when tyranny strikes them, they retaliate [in a just manner].
Indeed, Allāh orders justice and good conduct and giving [help] to relatives and forbids immorality and bad conduct and oppression. He admonishes you that perhaps you will be reminded.

779.translation: And [by] the sky and He who constructed it
And constructed above you seven strong [heavens]

780.translation: [O disbelievers], eat and enjoy yourselves a little; indeed, you are criminals.
So they will deny what We have given them. Then enjoy yourselves, for you are going to know.

781.translation: And they sold him for a reduced price - a few dirhams - and they were, concerning him, of those content with little.
They have exchanged the signs of Allāh for a small price and averted [people] from His way. Indeed, it was evil that they were doing.

782.translation: O Prophet, sufficient for you is Allāh and for whoever follows you of the believers.
And when it is said to him, "Fear Allāh," pride in the sin takes hold of him. Sufficient for him is Hellfire, and how wretched is the resting place.

783.translation: So Allāh made them taste disgrace in worldly life. But the punishment of the Hereafter is greater, if they only knew.

Twisting his neck [in arrogance] to mislead [people] from the way of Allāh. For him in the world is disgrace, and We will make him taste on the Day of Resurrection the punishment of the Burning Fire [while it is said],

784.translation: Or that He would not seize them gradually [in a state of dread]? But indeed, your Lord is Kind and Merciful.
And if it had not been for the favor of Allāh upon you and His mercy... and because Allāh is Kind and Merciful.

785.translation: But you wonder, while they mock,
And already were messengers ridiculed before you, but those who mocked them were enveloped by that which they used to ridicule.

786.translation: And if you speak aloud - then indeed, He knows the secret and what is [even] more hidden.
Did they not know that Allāh knows their secrets and their private conversations and that Allāh is the Knower of the unseen?

787.translation: [So he was told], "Strike [the ground] with your foot; this is a [spring for a] cool bath and drink."
They will not taste therein [any] coolness or drink.

788.translation: When Shuʿayb said to them, "Will you not fear Allāh?
Said the eminent ones who disbelieved among his people, "If you should follow Shuʿayb, indeed, you would then be losers."

789.translation: And indeed, among his kind was Abraham,
And We have already destroyed your kinds, so is there any who will remember?

790.translation: Our Lord, give them double the punishment and curse them with a great curse."
They will say, "Our Lord, whoever brought this upon us - increase for him double punishment in the Fire."

791.translation: Thus does Allāh seal the hearts of those who do not know.
They were satisfied to be with those who stay behind, and their hearts were sealed over, so they do not understand.

792.translation: They said, "We found our fathers worshippers of them."
Nor are you worshippers of what I worship.

793.translation: [This is a declaration of] disassociation, from Allāh and His Messenger, to those with whom you had made a treaty among the polytheists.
Is it not [true] that every time they took a covenant a party of them threw it away? But, [in fact], most of them do not believe.

794.translation: O you who have believed, when you marry believing women and then divorce them before you have touched them [i.e., consummated the marriage], then there is not for you any waiting period to count concerning them. So provide for them and give them a gracious release.

And those who no longer expect menstruation among your women - if you doubt, then their period is three months, and [also for] those who have not menstruated. And for those who are pregnant, their term is until they give birth. And whoever fears Allāh - He will make for him of his matter ease.

795.translation: Gardens of perpetual residence, whose doors will be opened to them.
[Therein are] gardens of perpetual residence which the Most Merciful has promised His servants in the unseen. Indeed, His promise has ever been eminent.

796.translation: Indeed, We have sent it down as an Arabic Qur’ān that you might understand.

797.translation: And We will present Hell that Day to the disbelievers, on display -
[Mention] when there were exhibited before him in the afternoon the poised [standing] racehorses.

798.translation: [Iblees] said, "By Your might, I will surely mislead them all
Exalted is your Lord, the Lord of might, above what they describe.

799.translation: And We raised him to a high station.
And indeed it is, in the Mother of the Book with Us, exalted and full of wisdom.

800.translation: And We placed therein gardens of palm trees and grapevines and caused to burst forth therefrom some springs -
Or [until] you have a garden of palm trees and grapes and make rivers gush forth within them in force [and abundance]

801.translation: And fruit of what they select
In both of them are fruit and palm trees and pomegranates.

802.translation: And those who disbelieved are allies of one another. If you do not do so [i.e., ally yourselves with other believers], there will be fitnah [i.e., disbelief and oppression] on earth and great corruption.

803.translation: Indeed, all things We created with predestination.

804.translation: They have not appraised Allāh with true appraisal. Indeed, Allāh is Powerful and Exalted in Might.
Allāh is Subtle with His servants; He gives provision to whom He wills. And He is the Powerful, the Exalted in Might.

805.translation: For you therein is much fruit from which you will eat.
Reclining within them, they will call therein for abundant fruit and drink.

806.translation: The heart did not lie [about] what it saw.
See how they will lie about themselves. And lost from them will be what they used to invent.

807.translation: Wearing [garments of] fine silk and brocade, facing each other.
And do not mix the truth with falsehood or conceal the truth while you know [it].

808.translation: And your companion [i.e., Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ) ] is not [at all] mad.
You are not, [O Muḥammad], by the favor of your Lord, a madman.

809.translation: Say, "Allāh [alone] do I worship, sincere to Him in my religion,
So invoke Allāh, [being] sincere to Him in religion, although the disbelievers dislike it.

810.translation: Never would the Messiah disdain to be a servant of Allāh, nor would the angels near [to Him]. And whoever disdains His worship and is arrogant - He will gather them to Himself all together.

[And mention] when the angels said, "O Mary, indeed Allāh gives you good tidings of a word from Him, whose name will be the Messiah, Jesus, the son of Mary - distinguished in this world and the Hereafter and among those brought near [to Allāh].

811.translation: [He is] Lord of the two sunrises and Lord of the two sunsets.
Lord of the heavens and the earth and that between them and Lord of the sunrises.

812.translation: Until the Day of the time well-known."

813.translation: But Allāh is your protector, and He is the best of helpers.
Then he [i.e., man] will have no power or any helper.

814.translation: So they disputed over their affair among themselves and concealed their private conversation.
Did they not know that Allāh knows their secrets and their private conversations and that Allāh is the Knower of the unseen?

815.translation: And fields of crops and palm trees with softened fruit?
In both of them are fruit and palm trees and pomegranates.

816.translation: He invokes one whose harm is closer than his benefit - how wretched the protector and how wretched the associate.
Did they not see that it could not return to them any speech [i.e., response] and that it did not possess for them any harm or benefit?

817.translation: For wrongdoing on the part of the Jews, We made unlawful for them [certain] good foods which had been lawful to them, and for their averting from the way of Allāh many [people],
And to those who are Jews We have prohibited that which We related to you before. And We did not wrong them [thereby], but they were wronging themselves.

818.translation: That is their recompense - Hell - for what they denied and [because] they took My signs and My messengers in ridicule.
And when they see you, [O Muḥammad], they take you not except in ridicule, [saying], "Is this the one whom Allāh has sent as a messenger?

819.translation: Nor does he speak from [his own] inclination.
Racing ahead, their heads raised up, their glance does not come back to them, and their hearts are void.

820.translation: And Abraham instructed his sons [to do the same] and [so did] Jacob, [saying], "O my sons, indeed Allāh has chosen for you this religion, so do not die except while you are Muslims."
And, [moreover], this is My path, which is straight, so follow it; and do not follow [other] ways, for you will be separated from His way. This has He instructed you that you may become righteous.

821.translation: And ease for me my task
Then He eased the way for him;

822.translation: And do not approach unlawful sexual intercourse. Indeed, it is ever an immorality and is evil as a way.
But if you do not bring him to me, no measure will there be [hereafter] for you from me, nor will you approach me."

823.translation: Never will you attain the good [reward] until you spend [in the way of Allāh] from that which you love. And whatever you spend - indeed, Allāh is Knowing of it.

[Allāh will say], "Are these the ones whom you [inhabitants of Hell] swore that Allāh would never offer them mercy? Enter Paradise, [O people of the Elevations]. No fear will there be concerning you, nor will you grieve."

824.translation: They swear by Allāh to you [Muslims] to satisfy you. But Allāh and His Messenger are more worthy for them to satisfy, if they were to be believers.

And how should I fear what you associate while you do not fear that you have associated with Allāh that for which He has not sent down to you any authority? So which of the two parties has more right to security, if you should know?"

825.translation: And be patient, for indeed, Allāh does not allow to be lost the reward of those who do good.
But those who hold fast to the Book [i.e., the Qur’ān] and establish prayer - indeed, We will not allow to be lost the reward of the reformers.

826.translation: The bedouins are stronger in disbelief and hypocrisy and more likely not to know the limits of what [laws] Allāh has revealed to His Messenger. And Allāh is Knowing and Wise.

They think the companies have not [yet] withdrawn. And if the companies should come [again], they would wish they were in the desert among the bedouins, inquiring [from afar] about your news. And if they should be among you, they would not fight except for a little.

827.translation: Provided you with grazing livestock and children
And We will provide them with fruit and meat from whatever they desire.

828.translation: And his Lord chose him and made him of the righteous.
Then his Lord chose him and turned to him in forgiveness and guided [him].

829.translation: For whoever wills among you to take a right course.
And [Allāh revealed] that if they had remained straight on the way, We would have given them abundant rain [i.e., provision]

830.translation: But as for he who withholds and considers himself free of need
If He should ask you for them and press you, you would withhold, and He would expose your hatred [i.e., unwillingness].

831.translation: My Lord, make me an establisher of prayer, and [many] from my descendants. Our Lord, and accept my supplication.
Say, "Spend willingly or unwillingly; never will it be accepted from you. Indeed, you have been a defiantly disobedient people."

832.translation: And if We had not strengthened you, you would have almost inclined to them a little.
O you who have believed, if you support Allāh, He will support you and plant firmly your feet.

833.translation: Take what is given freely, enjoin what is good, and turn away from the ignorant.
Say, [O Muḥammad], "Is it other than Allāh that you order me to worship, O ignorant ones?"

834.translation: And when you strike, you strike as tyrants.
And they requested decision [i.e., victory from Allāh], and disappointed, [therefore], was every obstinate tyrant.

835.translation: From among the jinn and mankind."
He is not but a man possessed with madness, so wait concerning him for a time."

836.translation: So they were struck by the evil consequences of what they did and were enveloped by what they used to ridicule.
So Allāh protected him from the evils they plotted, and the people of Pharaoh were enveloped by the worst of punishment -

837.translation: Striking them with stones of hard clay,

838.translation: And who I aspire that He will forgive me my sin on the Day of Recompense."
Because of their sins they were drowned and put into the Fire, and they found not for themselves besides Allāh [any] helpers.

839.translation: In them are good and beautiful women -
Is [because] We hasten for them good things? Rather, they do not perceive.

840.translation: So We sent upon them the flood and locusts and lice and frogs and blood as distinct signs, but they were arrogant and were a criminal people.
And [recall] when We took your covenant, [saying], "Do not shed your [i.e., each other's] blood or evict one another from your homes." Then you acknowledged [this] while you were witnessing.

841.translation: But as for those in whose hearts is disease, it has [only] increased them in evil [in addition] to their evil. And they will have died while they are disbelievers.
And it is not for a soul [i.e., anyone] to believe except by permission of Allāh, and He will place defilement upon those who will not use reason.

842.translation: I convey to you the messages of my Lord, and I am to you a trustworthy adviser.
[Allāh praises] those who convey the messages of Allāh and fear Him and do not fear anyone but Allāh. And sufficient is Allāh as Accountant.

843.translation: And We placed therein lofty, firmly set mountains and have given you to drink sweet water.
And the earth - We have spread it and cast therein firmly set mountains and caused to grow therein [something] of every well-balanced thing.

844.translation: And fields of crops and palm trees with softened fruit?

845.translation: Those will have a share of what they have earned, and Allāh is swift in account.
So that Allāh will recompense every soul for what it earned. Indeed, Allāh is swift in account.

846.translation: And that his effort is going to be seen -

847.translation: [This is] a sūrah which We have sent down and made [that within it] obligatory and revealed therein verses of clear evidence that you might remember.
Or do they say [about the Prophet (ﷺ)], "He invented it?" Say, "Then bring forth a sūrah like it and call upon [for assistance] whomever you can besides Allāh, if you should be truthful."

848.translation: And there will not be for them among their [alleged] partners any intercessors, and they will [then] be disbelievers in their partners.
Or have they taken other than Allāh as intercessors? Say, "Even though they do not possess [power over] anything, nor do they reason?"

849.translation: That He may give them in full their rewards and increase for them of His bounty. Indeed, He is Forgiving and Appreciative.
O descendants of those We carried [in the ship] with Noah. Indeed, he was a grateful servant.

850.translation: We have created you, so why do you not believe?
And those who believe in the Day of Recompense

851.translation: And thus do We diversify the verses so they [i.e., the disbelievers] will say, "You have studied," and so We may make it [i.e., the Qur’ān] clear for a people who know.
And We have certainly distributed it among them that they might be reminded, but most of the people refuse except disbelief.

852.translation: And the Horn will be blown. That is the Day of [carrying out] the threat.
Then when the Horn is blown with one blast

853.translation: Say, "Indeed, I do not possess for you [the power of] harm or right direction."
He invokes one whose harm is closer than his benefit - how wretched the protector and how wretched the associate.

854.translation: Perhaps his Lord, if he divorced you [all], would substitute for him wives better than you - submitting [to Allāh], believing, devoutly obedient, repentant, worshipping, and traveling - [ones] previously married and virgins.

O you who have believed, when you marry believing women and then divorce them before you have touched them [i.e., consummated the marriage], then there is not for you any waiting period to count concerning them. So provide for them and give them a gracious release.

855.translation: And We called him from the side of the mount at [his] right and brought him near, confiding [to him].
And [We brought forth] a tree issuing from Mount Sinai which produces oil and food [i.e., olives] for those who eat.

856.translation: So they [i.e., Gog and Magog] were unable to pass over it, nor were they able [to effect] in it any penetration.

Corruption has appeared throughout the land and sea by [reason of] what the hands of people have earned so He [i.e., Allāh] may let them taste part of [the consequence of] what they have done that perhaps they will return [to righteousness].

857.translation: Then he went to his family and came with a fat [roasted] calf.
And Moses had certainly brought you clear proofs. Then you took the calf [in worship] after that, while you were wrongdoers.

858.translation: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak
Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind,

859.translation: [Mention] when there were exhibited before him in the afternoon the poised [standing] racehorses.
And to Him is [due all] praise throughout the heavens and the earth. And [exalted is He] at night and when you are at noon.

860.translation: And there was for him no company to aid him other than Allāh, nor could he defend himself.
O you who have believed, when you encounter a company [from the enemy forces], stand firm and remember Allāh much that you may be successful.

861.translation: But those who deny Our verses - the punishment will touch them for their defiant disobedience.
Thus the word [i.e., decree] of your Lord has come into effect upon those who defiantly disobeyed - that they will not believe.

862.translation: Except for He who created me; and indeed, He will guide me."
And why should I not worship He who created me and to whom you will be returned?

863.translation: And his soul permitted to him the murder of his brother, so he killed him and became among the losers.
And do not kill your children for fear of poverty. We provide for them and for you. Indeed, their killing is ever a great sin.

864.translation: That we may exalt You much
In order that you not despair over what has eluded you and not exult [in pride] over what He has given you. And Allāh does not like everyone self-deluded and boastful -

865.translation: Give full measure and do not be of those who cause loss.
But if you do not bring him to me, no measure will there be [hereafter] for you from me, nor will you approach me."

866.translation: And made the night as clothing
And it is He who has made the night for you as clothing and sleep [a means for] rest and has made the day a resurrection.

867.translation: Had We intended to take a diversion, We could have taken it from [what is] with Us - if [indeed] We were to do so.
And the worldly life is not but amusement and diversion; but the home of the Hereafter is best for those who fear Allāh, so will you not reason?

868.translation: And We sent him to [his people of] a hundred thousand or more.
And they remained in their cave for three hundred years and exceeded by nine.

869.translation: And they denied him, so indeed, they will be brought [for punishment],
And indeed, all of them will yet be brought present before Us.

870.translation: Indeed, you are in differing speech.
That over which they are in disagreement.

871.translation: As if they had never prospered therein. Then, away with Madyan as Thamūd was taken away.
And the inhabitants of Madyan. And Moses was denied, so I prolonged enjoyment for the disbelievers; then I seized them, and how [terrible] was My reproach.

872.translation: And indeed, you pass by them in the morning
And when they passed by them, they would exchange derisive glances.

873.translation: There is not upon the weak or upon the ill or upon those who do not find anything to spend any discomfort [i.e., guilt] when they are sincere to Allāh and His Messenger. There is not upon the doers of good any cause [for blame]. And Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.

There is not upon the blind any guilt or upon the lame any guilt or upon the ill any guilt [for remaining behind]. And whoever obeys Allāh and His Messenger - He will admit him to gardens beneath which rivers flow; but whoever turns away - He will punish him with a painful punishment.

874.translation: Indeed, it is evil as a settlement and residence."
To your Lord, that Day, is the [place of] permanence.

875.translation: Who, when disaster strikes them, say, "Indeed we belong to Allāh, and indeed to Him we will return."
And whatever strikes you of disaster - it is for what your hands have earned; but He pardons much.

876.translation: [He is] Lord of the two sunrises and Lord of the two sunsets.
So I swear by the Lord of [all] risings and settings that indeed We are able

877.translation: And indeed, they [i.e., those cities] are [situated] on an established road.
To whom will come a torment disgracing him and on whom will descend an enduring punishment."

878.translation: But We threw him onto the open shore while he was ill.
No! He will surely be thrown into the Crusher.

879.translation: And he drew out his hand; thereupon it was white [with radiance] for the observers.
And he drew out his hand; thereupon it was white for the observers.

880.translation: When their brother Hūd said to them, "Will you not fear Allāh?
And when Our command came, We saved Hūd and those who believed with him, by mercy from Us; and We saved them from a harsh punishment.

881.translation: And dutiful to his parents, and he was not a disobedient tyrant.
Our Lord, forgive me and my parents and the believers the Day the account is established."

882.translation: And those who join that which Allāh has ordered to be joined and fear their Lord and are afraid of the evil of [their] account,

[Allāh] said, "We will strengthen your arm through your brother and grant you both supremacy so they will not reach you. [It will be] through Our signs; you and those who follow you will be the predominant."

883.translation: He causes the night to enter the day and causes the day to enter the night, and He is Knowing of that within the breasts.
That is because Allāh causes the night to enter the day and causes the day to enter the night and because Allāh is Hearing and Seeing.

884.translation: He will say, "By Allāh, you almost ruined me.
They said, "By Allāh, indeed you are in your [same] old error."

885.translation: And all of them are coming to Him on the Day of Resurrection alone.
Indeed, what you are promised is coming, and you will not cause failure [to Allāh].

886.translation: They will circulate between it and scalding water, heated [to the utmost degree].
Now? And you had disobeyed [Him] before and were of the corrupters?

887.translation: And his nearest kindred who shelter him
Did He not find you an orphan and give [you] refuge?

888.translation: Kind speech and forgiveness are better than charity followed by injury. And Allāh is Free of need and Forbearing.
They will not harm you except for [some] annoyance. And if they fight you, they will show you their backs [i.e., retreat]; then they will not be aided.

889.translation: For those who swear not to have sexual relations with their wives is a waiting time of four months, but if they return [to normal relations] - then indeed, Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.
So travel freely, [O disbelievers], throughout the land [during] four months but know that you cannot cause failure to Allāh and that Allāh will disgrace the disbelievers.

890.translation: When Our verses are recited to him, he says, "Legends of the former peoples."
When Our verses are recited to him, he says, "Legends of the former peoples."

891.translation: And whoever is blind in this [life] will be blind in the Hereafter and more astray in way.
The ones who are gathered on their faces to Hell - those are the worst in position and farthest astray in [their] way.

892.translation: While he was in the higher [part of the] horizon.
And said, "I am your most exalted lord."

893.translation: Then they [i.e., the people] came toward him, hastening.
They said while approaching them, "What is it you are missing?"

894.translation: And I will give them time. Indeed, My plan is firm.
And I will give them time. Indeed, My plan is firm.

895.translation: But if they intend to deceive you - then sufficient for you is Allāh. It is He who supported you with His help and with the believers

And We did certainly give Moses the Scripture [i.e., the Torah] and followed up after him with messengers. And We gave Jesus, the son of Mary, clear proofs and supported him with the Pure Spirit [i.e., the angel Gabriel]. But is it [not] that every time a messenger came to you, [O Children of Israel], with what your souls did not desire, you were arrogant? And a party [of messengers] you denied and another party you killed.

896.translation: Is it falsehood [as] gods other than Allāh you desire?
Why, when you heard it, did not the believing men and believing women think good of themselves [i.e., one another] and say, "This is an obvious falsehood"?

897.translation: And those who avoid the major sins and immoralities, and when they are angry, they forgive,
If you avoid the major sins which you are forbidden, We will remove from you your lesser sins and admit you to a noble entrance [into Paradise].

898.translation: And you did not recite before it any scripture, nor did you inscribe one with your right hand. Then [i.e., otherwise] the falsifiers would have had [cause for] doubt.
Only those would ask permission of you who do not believe in Allāh and the Last Day and whose hearts have doubted, and they, in their doubt, are hesitating.

899.translation: Those who have believed and whose hearts are assured by the remembrance of Allāh. Unquestionably, by the remembrance of Allāh hearts are assured."
They said, "We wish to eat from it and let our hearts be reassured and know that you have been truthful to us and be among its witnesses."

900.translation: So they set out, while lowering their voices,
[They will be told], "Proceed to that which you used to deny.

901.translation: As a giver of good tidings and a warner; but most of them turn away, so they do not hear.

901.gloss: and a bearer of glad tidings
901.translation: [Through a messenger, saying], "Do not worship except Allāh. Indeed, I am to you from Him a warner and a bringer of good tidings,"

902.translation: Blessed is the name of your Lord, Owner of Majesty and Honor.
Blessed is He who sent down the Criterion upon His Servant that he may be to the worlds a warner -

903.translation: [That] I will surely fill Hell with you and those of them that follow you all together."
[Allāh] said, "Go, for whoever of them follows you, indeed Hell will be the recompense of [all of] you - an ample recompense.

904.translation: Those are the ones who have purchased error [in exchange] for guidance, so their transaction has brought no profit, nor were they guided.
O you who have believed, shall I guide you to a transaction that will save you from a painful punishment?

905.translation: And indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is a reminder for the righteous.
No! Indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is a reminder

906.translation: And We called him from the side of the mount at [his] right and brought him near, confiding [to him].
[So] they may not listen to the exalted assembly [of angels] and are pelted from every side,

907.translation: By which is melted that within their bellies and [their] skins.
Until, when they reach it, their hearing and their eyes and their skins will testify against them of what they used to do.

908.translation: And you love wealth with immense love.
And indeed he is, in love of wealth, intense.

909.translation: And proclaim to the people the ḥajj [pilgrimage]; they will come to you on foot and on every lean camel; they will come from every distant pass -

They ask you, [O Muḥammad], about the crescent moons. Say, "They are measurements of time for the people and for ḥajj [pilgrimage]." And it is not righteousness to enter houses from the back, but righteousness is [in] one who fears Allāh. And enter houses from their doors. And fear Allāh that you may succeed.

910.translation: And we used to enter into vain discourse with those who engaged [in it],
So leave them to converse vainly and amuse themselves until they meet their Day which they are promised.

911.translation: Say, "Not equal are the evil and the good, although the abundance of evil might impress you." So fear Allāh, O you of understanding, that you may be successful.

And give to the orphans their properties and do not substitute the defective [of your own] for the good [of theirs]. And do not consume their properties into your own. Indeed, that is ever a great sin.

912.translation: Then We made you successors in the land after them so that We may observe how you will do.
Is He [not best] who responds to the desperate one when he calls upon Him and removes evil and makes you inheritors of the earth? Is there a deity with Allāh? Little do you remember.

913.translation: But when We removed the punishment from them until a term which they were to reach, then at once they broke their word.
But those who strive against Our verses [seeking] to cause failure - for them will be a painful punishment of foul nature.

914.translation: It is the freeing of a slave

And those who pronounce ẓihār from their wives and then [wish to] go back on what they said - then [there must be] the freeing of a slave before they touch one another. That is what you are admonished thereby; and Allāh is Aware of what you do.

915.translation: [That] you will surely embark upon [i.e., experience] state after state.
And We created for them from the likes of it that which they ride.

916.translation: Indeed, it throws sparks [as huge] as a fortress,
Striking them with stones of hard clay,

917.translation: And Pharaoh said, "O Hāmān, construct for me a tower that I might reach the ways -

918.translation: It is He who shows you lightning, [causing] fear and aspiration, and generates the heavy clouds.
And if they were to see a fragment from the sky falling, they would say, "[It is merely] clouds heaped up."

919.translation: O sister [i.e., descendant] of Aaron, your father was not a man of evil, nor was your mother unchaste."
For those who do not believe in the Hereafter is the description [i.e., an attribute] of evil; and for Allāh is the highest attribute. And He is Exalted in Might, the Wise.

920.translation: O you who have believed, decreed upon you is fasting as it was decreed upon those before you that you may become righteous -

And he who does not find [a slave] - then a fast for two months consecutively before they touch one another; and he who is unable - then the feeding of sixty poor persons. That is for you to believe [completely] in Allāh and His Messenger; and those are the limits [set by] Allāh. And for the disbelievers is a painful punishment.

921.translation: And We have already sent [messengers] to nations before you, [O Muḥammad]; then We seized them with poverty and hardship that perhaps they might humble themselves [to Us].
Who spend [in the cause of Allāh] during ease and hardship and who restrain anger and who pardon the people - and Allāh loves the doers of good;

922.translation: [Noah] said, "O my people, there is not error in me, but I am a messenger from the Lord of the worlds.
Those are the ones who have purchased error [in exchange] for guidance, so their transaction has brought no profit, nor were they guided.

923.translation: [But] Allāh mocks them and prolongs them in their transgression [while] they wander blindly.
Whoever Allāh sends astray - there is no guide for him. And He leaves them in their transgression, wandering blindly.

924.translation: And [mention] when the angels said, "O Mary, indeed Allāh has chosen you and purified you and chosen you above the women of the worlds.

925.translation: They said, "We worship idols and remain to them devoted."
If We willed, We could make it [dry] debris, and you would remain in wonder,

926.translation: Then will come after that a year in which the people will be given rain and in which they will press [olives and grapes]."
Do they not see that they are tried every year once or twice but then they do not repent nor do they remember?

927.translation: No! They [i.e., those "gods"] will deny their worship of them and will be against them opponents [on the Day of Judgement].
And when the people are gathered [that Day], they [who were invoked] will be enemies to them, and they will be deniers of their worship.

928.translation: [He said], "Return them to me," and set about striking [their] legs and necks.
When the shackles are around their necks and the chains; they will be dragged

929.translation: You will not see therein a depression or an elevation."
[It is] an Arabic Qur’ān, without any deviance that they might become righteous.

930.translation: He [i.e., Satan] promises them and arouses desire in them. But Satan does not promise them except delusion.
And [remember] when the hypocrites and those in whose hearts is disease said, "Allāh and His Messenger did not promise us except delusion,"

931.translation: When the shackles are around their necks and the chains; they will be dragged
Indeed, We have prepared for the disbelievers chains and shackles and a blaze.

932.translation: We grant them enjoyment for a little; then We will force them to a massive punishment.
And how could you take it while you have gone in unto each other and they have taken from you a solemn covenant?

933.translation: And they who are observant of zakāh
They said, "We will attempt to dissuade his father from [keeping] him, and indeed, we will do [it]."

934.translation: [This is] a sūrah which We have sent down and made [that within it] obligatory and revealed therein verses of clear evidence that you might remember.
Allāh has already ordained for you [Muslims] the dissolution of your oaths. And Allāh is your protector, and He is the Knowing, the Wise.

935.translation: [Or] of those who have divided their religion and become sects, every faction rejoicing in what it has.
But they who believe in Allāh and His messengers and do not discriminate between any of them - to those He is going to give their rewards. And ever is Allāh Forgiving and Merciful.

936.translation: Indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is a decisive statement,
Indeed, the Day of Judgement is the appointed time for them all -

937.translation: Say, "Indeed, my Lord projects the truth, Knower of the unseen."
[So] they may not listen to the exalted assembly [of angels] and are pelted from every side,

938.translation: [It is] Hell, which they will [enter to] burn, and wretched is the settlement.
And We placed it in a firm lodging [i.e., the womb]

939.translation: As if they had never prospered therein. Then, away with Madyan as Thamūd was taken away.
Those who denied Shuʿayb - it was as though they had never resided there. Those who denied Shuʿayb - it was they who were the losers.

940.translation: And they who turn away from ill speech
They will not hear therein ill speech or commission of sin -

941.translation: And [He has subjected] whatever He multiplied for you on the earth of varying colors. Indeed in that is a sign for a people who remember.
And of His signs is the creation of the heavens and the earth and the diversity of your languages and your colors. Indeed in that are signs for those of knowledge.

942.translation: This [is so]. But indeed, for the transgressors is an evil place of return -
Those who have believed and done righteous deeds - a good state is theirs and a good return.

943.translation: And We have not sent you, [O Muḥammad], except as a bringer of good tidings and a warner.

943.gloss: and (as) a bearer of glad tidings
943.translation: Indeed, We have sent you as a witness and a bringer of good tidings and a warner

944.translation: Do they not think that they will be resurrected
When we have died and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected?

945.translation: And they say, "When is [the fulfillment of] this promise, if you should be truthful?"
And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful?"

946.translation: While Allāh encompasses them from behind.
And to Allāh belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. And ever is Allāh, of all things, encompassing.

947.translation: Except, among them, Your chosen servants."
But not the chosen servants of Allāh.

948.translation: This [Qur’ān] is a clear statement to [all] the people and a guidance and instruction for those conscious of Allāh.
And We made it a deterrent punishment for those who were present and those who succeeded [them] and a lesson for those who fear Allāh.

949.translation: That We may bring forth thereby grain and vegetation
And Allāh has caused you to grow from the earth a [progressive] growth.

950.translation: And they [i.e., Pharaoh and his people] were overcome right there and became debased.
There the believers were tested and shaken with a severe shaking.

951.translation: But if they separate [by divorce], Allāh will enrich each [of them] from His abundance. And ever is Allāh Encompassing and Wise.
And to Allāh belongs the east and the west. So wherever you [might] turn, there is the Face of Allāh. Indeed, Allāh is all-Encompassing and Knowing.

952.translation: And [by] the father and that which was born [of him],
"Allāh has begotten," and indeed, they are liars.

953.translation: [Moses] said, "Do not blame me for what I forgot and do not overwhelm me in my matter with difficulty."
Allāh does not impose blame upon you for what is unintentional in your oaths, but He imposes blame upon you for what your hearts have earned. And Allāh is Forgiving and Forbearing.

954.translation: [Who will be] in gardens, questioning each other
And they will approach one another asking [i.e., blaming] each other.

955.translation: Is [because] We hasten for them good things? Rather, they do not perceive.
And hasten to forgiveness from your Lord and a garden [i.e., Paradise] as wide as the heavens and earth, prepared for the righteous

956.translation: And [recall] when We saved you [i.e., your forefathers] from the people of Pharaoh, who afflicted you with the worst torment, slaughtering your [newborn] sons and keeping your females alive. And in that was a great trial from your Lord.

And [recall, O Children of Israel], when We saved you from the people of Pharaoh, [who were] afflicting you with the worst torment - killing your sons and keeping your women alive. And in that was a great trial from your Lord.

957.translation: Multiplied for him is the punishment on the Day of Resurrection, and he will abide therein humiliated -
Who is it that would loan Allāh a goodly loan so He will multiply it for him and he will have a noble reward?

958.translation: And it is He who accepts repentance from His servants and pardons misdeeds, and He knows what you do.
And whoever desires other than Islām as religion - never will it be accepted from him, and he, in the Hereafter, will be among the losers.

959.translation: But they are in doubt, amusing themselves.
Who are in [empty] discourse amusing themselves.

960.translation: What is [wrong] with you that you do not speak?"
Nor does he speak from [his own] inclination.

961.translation: Abraham was neither a Jew nor a Christian, but he was one inclining toward truth, a Muslim [submitting to Allāh]. And he was not of the polytheists.

O you who have believed, do not take the Jews and the Christians as allies. They are [in fact] allies of one another. And whoever is an ally to them among you - then indeed, he is [one] of them. Indeed, Allāh guides not the wrongdoing people.

962.translation: White and delicious to the drinkers;
And he drew out his hand; thereupon it was white [with radiance] for the observers.

963.translation: And [mention] the Day He will call them and say, "What did you answer the messengers?"
[Allāh] said, "Your supplication has been answered." So remain on a right course and follow not the way of those who do not know."

964.gloss: They will be given to drink
964.translation: They will be given to drink [pure] wine [which was] sealed.

964.gloss: And they will be given to drink
964.translation: And they will be given to drink a cup [of wine] whose mixture is of ginger

965.translation: And when he [i.e., Joseph] reached maturity, We gave him judgement and knowledge. And thus We reward the doers of good.
And when he attained his full strength and was [mentally] mature, We bestowed upon him judgement and knowledge. And thus do We reward the doers of good.

966.translation: [He is] Knower of the unseen, and He does not disclose His [knowledge of the] unseen to anyone
And to Him is [due all] praise throughout the heavens and the earth. And [exalted is He] at night and when you are at noon.

967.translation: And gave a little and [then] refrained?
Indeed, We have granted you, [O Muḥammad], al-Kawthar.

968.translation: And we led you to deviation; indeed, we were deviators."
[Iblees] said, "By Your might, I will surely mislead them all

969.translation: And whoever desires other than Islām as religion - never will it be accepted from him, and he, in the Hereafter, will be among the losers.
And who is more unjust than one who invents about Allāh untruth while he is being invited to Islām. And Allāh does not guide the wrongdoing people.

970.translation: There the believers were tested and shaken with a severe shaking.
Indeed, We created man from a sperm-drop mixture that We may try him; and We made him hearing and seeing.

971.translation: They will say while they dispute therein,
Then indeed you, on the Day of Resurrection, before your Lord, will dispute.

972.translation: Racing ahead, their heads raised up, their glance does not come back to them, and their hearts are void.
[Moses] said, "That is what we were seeking." So they returned, following their footprints.

973.translation: And they remained in their cave for three hundred years and exceeded by nine.
Indeed, those who disbelieve [i.e., reject the message] after their belief and then increase in disbelief - never will their [claimed] repentance be accepted, and they are the ones astray.

974.translation: And We wanted to confer favor upon those who were oppressed in the land and make them leaders and make them inheritors
Those who were arrogant will say to those who were oppressed, "Did we avert you from guidance after it had come to you? Rather, you were criminals."

975.translation: And fruits from whatever they desire,
And the meat of fowl, from whatever they desire.

976.translation: And We delivered him and Lot to the land which We had blessed for the worlds [i.e., peoples].
And We blessed him and Isaac. But among their descendants is the doer of good and the clearly unjust to himself [i.e., sinner].

977.translation: Do you order righteousness of the people and forget yourselves while you recite the Scripture? Then will you not reason?
Never will you attain the good [reward] until you spend [in the way of Allāh] from that which you love. And whatever you spend - indeed, Allāh is Knowing of it.

978.translation: O mankind, there has come to you a conclusive proof from your Lord, and We have sent down to you a clear light.
And We will extract from every nation a witness and say, "Produce your proof," and they will know that the truth belongs to Allāh, and lost from them is that which they used to invent.

979.translation: But what would make you perceive, [O Muḥammad], that perhaps he might be purified
He has certainly succeeded who purifies himself

980.translation: And when it is said to them, "Come, the Messenger of Allāh will ask forgiveness for you," they turn their heads aside and you see them evading while they are arrogant.
And when it is said to them, "Come to what Allāh has revealed and to the Messenger," you see the hypocrites turning away from you in aversion.

981.translation: And the Day the Hour appears - that Day they will become separated.
But if they separate [by divorce], Allāh will enrich each [of them] from His abundance. And ever is Allāh Encompassing and Wise.

982.translation: Proceed to a shadow [of smoke] having three columns
And they remained in their cave for three hundred years and exceeded by nine.

983.translation: Upon them [i.e., the inhabitants] will be green garments of fine silk and brocade. And they will be adorned with bracelets of silver, and their Lord will give them a purifying drink.
And indeed, every time I invited them that You may forgive them, they put their fingers in their ears, covered themselves with their garments, persisted, and were arrogant with [great] arrogance.

984.translation: If He wills, He can do away with you and bring forth a new creation.
And they say, "When we are bones and crumbled particles, will we [truly] be resurrected as a new creation?"

985.translation: Their sides part [i.e., they arise] from [their] beds; they supplicate their Lord in fear and aspiration, and from what We have provided them, they spend.
Lest a soul should say, "Oh, [how great is] my regret over what I neglected in regard to Allāh and that I was among the mockers."

986.translation: Or do they have the depositories of the mercy of your Lord, the Exalted in Might, the Bestower?
Or have they the depositories [containing the provision] of your Lord? Or are they the controllers [of them]?

987.translation: Do you feel secure that He who is above would not cause the earth to swallow you and suddenly it would sway?

988.translation: Indeed, they who are apprehensive from fear of their Lord
And do not kill your children for fear of poverty. We provide for them and for you. Indeed, their killing is ever a great sin.

989.translation: And Allāh wants to lighten for you [your difficulties]; and mankind was created weak.
Abiding eternally therein. The punishment will not be lightened for them, nor will they be reprieved.

990.translation: Or [until] you have a garden of palm trees and grapes and make rivers gush forth within them in force [and abundance]
Each of the two gardens produced its fruit and did not fall short thereof in anything. And We caused to gush forth within them a river.

992.translation: Then why have there not been placed upon him bracelets of gold or come with him the angels in conjunction?"
[For them are] gardens of perpetual residence which they will enter. They will be adorned therein with bracelets of gold and pearls, and their garments therein will be silk.

993.translation: And establish prayer and give zakāh and bow with those who bow [in worship and obedience].
O Mary, be devoutly obedient to your Lord and prostrate and bow with those who bow [in prayer]."

994.gloss: We will try to get permission
994.translation: They said, "We will attempt to dissuade his father from [keeping] him, and indeed, we will do [it]."
And they had demanded from him his guests, but We obliterated their eyes, [saying], "Taste My punishment and warning."

995.translation: And that declaration of theirs did not cease until We made them [as] a harvest [mowed down], extinguished [like a fire].
And if your Lord had willed, He could have made mankind one community; but they will not cease to differ,

996.translation: [From] a fountain within it [i.e., Paradise] named Salsabeel.
Indeed, those who do not believe in the Hereafter name the angels female names,

997.translation: And the companions of the left - what are the companions of the left?
[To sit] on [your] right and [your] left in separate groups?

998.translation: But they were insolent toward the command of their Lord, so the thunderbolt seized them while they were looking on.
But if they turn away, then say, "I have warned you of a thunderbolt like the thunderbolt [that struck] ʿAad and Thamūd.

999.translation: And when the pages are spread [i.e., made public]

1000.translation: And be moderate in your pace and lower your voice; indeed, the most disagreeable of sounds is the voice of donkeys."

That Day, they [i.e., everyone] will follow [the call of] the Caller [with] no deviation therefrom, and [all] voices will be stilled before the Most Merciful, so you will not hear except a whisper [of footsteps].
